name: Mariner 2
tagline: Venus flyby, December 1962: NASA's first successful planetary science mission
description: A 202.8 kg NASA spacecraft launched on 1962-08-27 on an Atlas-Agena B. It carried a magnetometer, particle detectors, a cosmic ray detector, a cosmic dust detector, a solar plasma spectrometer, and microwave and infrared radiometers. It passed Venus on 1962-12-14 at 34,773 km and contact ended on 1963-01-03. NASA says it keeps the honor of being the very first successful planetary science mission in history.
best_known_for: Venus flyby, December 1962: NASA's first successful planetary science mission
